faqs: Do service exporters need an IEC?
Banks can process service export remittances without one, but export benefits and many compliance simplifications require it. For any serious services exporter, we recommend taking it.
Is there any return or renewal for IEC?
No returns, but the annual electronic update between April and June is mandatory even if nothing changed. Missing it deactivates the IEC until updated.

What is an AD code and do I need it too?
The AD code links your bank to the customs port for foreign exchange reporting. Importer exporters must register it at each port they ship through, which we help set up after the IEC.

States recover back tax with interest and penalties on assessment. Voluntary registration with back payment is consistently cheaper, and we negotiate the regularisation.
Do remote employees create professional tax liability?
Employees working from a levy state can create obligations there even without an office. Remote first companies should get their state matrix reviewed, which we do as standard onboarding.
